metadata.title: Exotic smooth structures on nonorientable 4-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We construct closed nonorientable aspherical 4-manifolds with an arbitrarily large number of distinct smooth structures. This uses the reflection trick of Davis-Hayden-Huang-Ruberman-Sunukjian. Our examples become mutually diffeomorphic after either type of stabilization: taking a product with the real line, or taking a connected sum with sufficiently many copies of S^2 x S^2.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 非定向四维流形的异型光滑结构
analysis.workSummary: 作者用Davis–Hayden–Huang–Ruberman–Sunukjian反射技巧，构造具有任意多种彼此不同光滑结构的闭非定向非球面四维流形。对这些例子，取与实线的乘积，或与足够多份S²×S²连通和后，所得光滑流形互相微分同胚。
analysis.breakthrough: 在非定向且非球面的闭四维情形实现任意大的有限异型族，并得到两种稳定化结论。
analysis.limitations: 稳定结论限于作者构造的例子。摘要未指定稳定所需的连通和份数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第7页披露ChatGPT生成插图、编制参考文献及校对，记录literature、writing。作者还曾询问能否用全亏格函数构造无限异型族，记exploration。作者说明这一探索未进入论文内容。该页另有Jean-Claude Hausmann的姓名误命中。
